identity.statusNote: podcasters.spotify.com now redirects (301) to creators.spotify.com; the product has been rebranded from 'Spotify for Podcasters' to 'Spotify for Creators' and now supports both audio and video podcasts.

freePlan.limits: Free hosting and distribution tools for podcast creators, with optional monetization through the Spotify Partner Program

keyLimits.en: Free hosting and distribution tools for podcast creators, with optional monetization through the Spotify Partner Program

cautions.en: No paid subscription tier is advertised on the homepage; monetization is revenue-share based through the Spotify Partner Program rather than a flat plan price.

capabilities.en: Upload and distribute audio and video podcast episodes to Spotify listeners.
Audience engagement tools including clip creation and comment management.
Built-in analytics for tracking episode performance and audience growth.
Monetization options through the Spotify Partner Program for eligible creators.

limitations.en: No advanced/paid tier is documented; deeper analytics or team collaboration features beyond the free toolset are not detailed on the homepage.
Distribution and growth tools are centered on the Spotify platform itself; cross-platform (Apple Podcasts, etc.) distribution mechanics are not detailed on this page.

reason.en: Dedicated podcast hosting platform with cross-platform distribution, a common alternative for creators wanting a host independent of one listening app.
Podcast hosting and monetization competitor covering the same creator workflow.
Podcast hosting and ad monetization network competing for the same creator audience.

unknowns: Monetization eligibility criteria (region, audience size) for the Spotify Partner Program were not detailed on the homepage in this session.
Whether any paid/pro tier exists for larger creators or networks was not confirmed.
